posts.post:
Kind of interesting: people will spend thousands on skincare but refuse to pay for natural fibers.

Your polyester blouse is suffocating your skin while you pay to fix the irritation.

Friendly reminder that expensive logos are just tax for people who don't understand fabric quality.

Stop paying for the label and start paying for the weave.

How to know if you have a good wardrobe: you can get dressed in the dark and still look composed.

If it requires styling, it is a costume, not a closet.
You don’t need to be trendy. Just be intentional and people will assume you are wealthy.
